relationship.instructions: Given query, Webmaster overlap metrics, and two supplied page title/summary snapshots, decide whether their user intents compete. Showing for the same query is not proof of harmful cannibalization.

criteria.competing: Both pages predominantly serve the same user need and appear to be close substitutes
criteria.complementary: Pages address different related sub-needs and may both be useful
criteria.separate: Pages serve clearly different intents despite sharing some query words
criteria.insufficient: Page snapshots or search evidence insufficient to judge relationship

same_intent.instructions: Based only on both supplied page descriptions and the shared query, do these pages substantially target the same dominant search intent?

consolidation_priority.instructions: How important is a HUMAN SEO review of potential consolidation or differentiation, not an automatic merge?
criteria: Worth assessing their query/CTR and differences
Strong duplicate-intent warning requiring manual investigation
